summary: All changes from coder, tester, and documenter agents integrate cleanly. The feature scopes agent prompts to role-relevant context: execution roles (tester, documenter, integrator) receive summarized backgrounds with structured task info instead of the full issue body, while analysis roles retain the full issue. Phase-scoped coders see the plan overview instead of the full plan. 133 prompt-related tests pass (34 from coder + 40 tester-authored edge cases + 59 pre-existing). Full orchestrator suite: 736 passed, 3 pre-existing failures in test_docker_client.py. Lint passes clean.

pipeline_prompts_tests.details: orchestrator/tests/test_pipeline_prompts.py — 133 tests covering _summarize_issue, _extract_plan_overview, _build_role_context, _build_agent_prompt role context, _build_phase_scoped_prompt overview, plus edge cases for all functions. All pass.

orchestrator_full_suite.details: 736 passed. 3 pre-existing failures in test_docker_client.py: TestDockerClientConnection.test_is_connected_false, TestContainerCreation.test_create_container_image_not_found, TestContainerOperations.test_start_container_not_found. All due to Docker mock exception handling issues unrelated to this PR.

lint.details: ruff check passes clean on both orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py and orchestrator/tests/test_pipeline_prompts.py.

new_helper_functions.details: _summarize_issue() extracts 1-2 sentence summaries from issue body. _extract_plan_overview() strips phase details and yaml-tasks from plan text. _build_role_context() dispatches to full body (analysis roles) or summary+pointers (execution roles). All three functions have matching tests covering normal and edge cases.

agent_prompt_role_dispatch.details: _build_agent_prompt() now calls _build_role_context() instead of embedding pipeline.prompt verbatim. Analysis roles (architect, task_planner, risk_analyst) get ## Task Description with full body. Execution roles (tester, documenter, integrator) get ## Background with summary + ## For More Context pointers. New phase_obj and all_phases params properly threaded through.

phase_scoped_prompt_changes.details: _build_phase_scoped_prompt() embeds plan overview (not full plan) via _extract_plan_overview() on first cycle. Adds one-line summaries of other phases for orientation. Includes pointer to full plan file. Review cycle > 0 correctly skips plan embedding. New all_phases param propagated from _run_tier3_implement().

tier3_implement_call_sites.details: _run_tier3_implement() passes phase_obj and all_phases=contract.phases to coder (_build_phase_scoped_prompt), tester (_build_agent_prompt), documenter (_build_agent_prompt), and integrator (_build_agent_prompt). Previously ad-hoc tester phase scope lines removed — now handled by _build_role_context(). Documenter now also gets phase scoping (was previously missing).

backward_compatibility.details: New parameters phase_obj and all_phases default to None. Existing call sites without these params continue to work. Coder/refiner roles still delegate to _build_phase_prompt() unchanged. 59 pre-existing prompt tests continue to pass.

documentation_updates.details: Three doc files updated: docs/architecture/orchestrator.md adds Prompt Context Scoping subsection. docs/guides/agent-development.md adds Prompt Context Scoping section with guidance for adding new roles. docs/guides/sdlc-pipeline.md adds Role-Specific Prompt Context section and updates Phase-scoped prompts description.

pre_existing_issues.description: 3 tests in orchestrator/tests/test_docker_client.py fail due to Docker mock exception handling issues. test_is_connected_false asserts False but gets True; test_create_container_image_not_found and test_start_container_not_found hit TypeError from mocked exceptions. Present on main branch, not introduced by this PR.
